summary: Every AAP server should sync time with an NTP pool or your organization's NTP service (for example with chrony) so logs and audit events have accurate timestamps, schedules run on time and inter-component messages are not rejected on timeouts.
questions: Why does AAP need NTP time sync?
How do I configure time synchronization for AAP servers?
Scheduled jobs running at the wrong time in AAP
AAP components rejecting messages due to clock skew
